title: Ask HN: Why hasn't there been a real competitor to Ticketmaster yet?
summary: A Hacker News discussion questioning why Ticketmaster maintains near-monopoly control over the ticketing market despite widespread criticism, noting that other platforms primarily handle resale rather than competing directly with primary ticket sales.
problem_solved: This post explores why no competitor has disrupted Ticketmaster's dominant market position in event ticketing.
why_valuable: It highlights the structural barriers to competition in the ticketing industry, including exclusive venue contracts, network effects, and vertical integration that create high barriers to entry.
